# Flash sale — Style Prompt

> A poster that shouts, built by impacts. A full-frame flash, two words slam in, a giant percent bursts in spinning and shakes, two ribbons cross and run the offer in opposite directions, the deadline is stamped into a pill, and a circle of colour opens onto the name and the contact. Two hard colours on near-black, heavy type, nothing soft.

## 1. Essence, and what it is not

The film is a **sale poster assembled by hits**. The top two thirds build once and stay: the two-word headline (from y 300), the percent (440 px, from y 680) and a short word tucked under its right edge. The band around y 1280 changes: first two crossed ribbons, then the deadline. Each element arrives as an impact (a slam, a burst, a slide, a stamp), six of them in the first 2.8 s, and then the poster holds so the deadline reads for over 5 s. The ending is a different colour field that opens like an iris.

Not a ticking countdown (the deadline is written as text, so it is still true whenever the video is watched), not a carousel of deals (one number, one offer), not glitch art (no colour splitting or noise; the only shake is ten 14 px nudges), not a price comparison (that is the compare role, struck price and new price).

## 2. Materials & rendering

- **Ground**: flat near-black with a grid of 2 px lines every 120 px in the text colour at 18 % opacity, oversized 200 px on every side and drifting down 240 px over the film.
- **Flash**: a full-frame panel in the main colour, fully on at the first frame and gone in 0.35 s; reused at 35 % for a 0.12 s blink when the deadline lands.
- **Type as objects**: the headline words, the percent and its short word are separate blocks that scale, spin and slide whole. Letters never move on their own.
- **Ribbons**: two bands 1480 × 120 that overrun the frame by 200 px on each side, one in the main colour turned −7°, one in the accent turned +5°, crossing around y 1285. Each repeats a two-word phrase with bullets, four times, so the run never shows an end.
- **Deadline pill**: a letter-spaced caps label over a main-colour pill (radius 26) carrying the day and time.
- **End field**: the accent fills the frame through a growing circular `clip-path`, with the name, a pill in the background colour and the contact.

## 3. Colour logic

- `--latar`: the ground, and the button on the end field. `--teks`: the first headline word and the grid lines.
- `--utama`: the first loud colour: the flash, the second headline word, the short word under the percent, the first ribbon, the deadline label and pill, the button's text on the end field.
- `--teks-di-utama`: text on the first ribbon and in the deadline pill.
- `--aksen`: the second loud colour: the giant percent, the second ribbon, the end field. Text on it is `--teks-di-aksen`, derived from the accent's lightness (near-black above OKLCH L 0.68, white below), because a brand can bring any accent.
- `--latar-2` and `--teks-redup` are not used in the example: give them a card behind small print or a secondary line if you add one.
- Two loud colours fighting on near-black is the look. When the brand has no accent, keep this pink or choose another hot colour far from the main one, never a tint of the main colour.

## 4. Type

- `--font-judul` carries everything that shouts, Archivo Black by default: the headline 170 px uppercase, line-height 0.95, one word per line; the percent 440 px with letter-spacing −12 px; the short word 120 px; ribbon text 70 px with letter-spacing 4 px; the deadline 80 px; the end name 120 px (it may wrap to two lines). A condensed face such as Bebas Neue holds at the same sizes but reads lighter; a wider one such as Poppins 800 needs about 85 %.
- `--font-isi` carries the quieter words, Space Grotesk by default: the deadline label 56 px 700 uppercase with letter-spacing 8 px, the button 62 px 700, the contact 52 px 500.
- Short words only: headline words up to about 7 characters (623 px for a 5-letter word at 170 px), a number of at most three characters (991 px for "50%"), two-word ribbon phrases.

## 5. Motion quality

- **Flash**: opacity 1 → 0 in 0.35 s `power2.out`, starting at 0.05 s.
- **Slam**: each headline word from scale 2.6 (origin at its left edge) and transparent to rest, 0.45 s `expo.out`, staggered 0.22 s.
- **Burst**: the percent from scale 0.2, −20° and transparent to rest, 0.7 s `back.out(2.2)`; then ten nudges of 14 px on x, 0.05 s each, linear (0.5 s in all).
- **Slide**: the short word in from 300 px to the right, 0.5 s `expo.out`.
- **Ribbons**: in from opposite sides (`xPercent: −100` and `+100`), 0.6 s `expo.out`, 0.2 s apart; their text runs 900 px in 9 s (100 px per second), linear, in opposite directions; after about 2.4 s both leave together, up 170 % of their height with a fade, 0.4 s `power2.in`.
- **Stamp**: the label rises 80 px (0.5 s `power3.out`); 0.2 s later the pill lands from scale 1.8 and −6° in 0.45 s `expo.out` with a flash blink to 35 % (0.06 s up, 0.06 s down); then it holds 5.3 s.
- **Iris**: `clip-path: circle(0% → 75%)` from the centre, 0.8 s `expo.inOut`; the contents rise 80 px with a fade, 0.5 s `power3.out`, staggered 0.12 s; everything holds about 2.3 s and the film fades out over the last 0.5 s.
- **Rhythm**: hits at 0.15, 0.37, 0.8, 1.6, 2.0 and 2.2 s, then one at 5.2 s and one at 11 s. Hit fast, hold long.

## 6. Camera grammar

The frame is fixed. Impacts do the work a camera would.

| Move | What it expresses | Can serve |
|---|---|---|
| Full-frame flash | the alarm, "now" | the opening, a reveal, a stamp landing |
| Slam from 2.6× | shouting a word | a sale's name, a challenge title, a warning |
| Spinning burst and shake | the number is the news | a discount, a follower milestone, a score |
| Crossed ribbons running | urgency, everything at once | the offer's scope, dates, hashtags |
| Stamp with a blink | official, fixed | a deadline, a code, "HABIS" |
| Iris opening onto a colour field | the noise ends, the ask | name, button, contact |

## 7. Native moves

- **Flash and slam.** The frame flashes the main colour, then two words slam in from 2.6× one after the other. *Fits content like:* "FLASH SALE!" for a shoe shop; "HADIAH GRATIS!" for a creator's giveaway; "UJIAN BESOK!" for a study channel's revision video; "PLOT TWIST" in a short story.
- **Bursting number.** One giant figure bursts in spinning, shakes, and a short word slides in under it. *Fits content like:* "50%" with "OFF"; "10K" with "FOLLOWER"; "3" with "HARI LAGI"; "#1" with "TERLARIS".
- **Crossed ribbons.** Two tapes in the two loud colours cross and run their phrase in opposite directions. *Fits content like:* "SEMUA SNEAKERS • SAMPAI MINGGU"; "EARLY BIRD • KUOTA 30"; "PART 2 • MALAM INI"; "STOK TERBATAS • BISA COD".
- **Stamped deadline.** A label rises and a pill is stamped under it with a blink, then holds. *Fits content like:* "Minggu, 23.59 WIB"; "Pendaftaran tutup 30 November"; "Live jam 19.00"; "Kode: HEMAT50".
- **Iris ending.** A circle of the accent opens from the centre onto the name, a button and the contact. *Fits content like:* a shop name with "Belanja sekarang"; a channel with "Ikuti untuk part 2"; a class with "Daftar sekarang"; a story's title with "Baca lanjutannya".

## 8. Pitfalls

- A live countdown or a date computed from the clock is wrong the day after the render: write the deadline as text.
- The percent fills its box at three characters: "100%" or a price at 440 px overflows. Use a shorter figure or drop to about 330 px.
- Headline words over about 7 characters at 170 px overflow the 940 px box: shorten them or scale the headline down, never let a word break.
- Hits too close together blur into noise: keep at least 0.2 s between impacts, and let the deadline hold 3 s or more.
- Text on the accent (the second ribbon, the end field) in `--teks` instead of `--teks-di-aksen` disappears when a brand's accent is light.
- The percent is accent-coloured text on the background: if a brand's accent sits close to its background, set the percent in `--utama` and the short word in `--teks`.
- A shake with many repeats, long nudges or random offsets looks like a bug. Ten nudges of 14 px is the budget; never `Math.random()`.
- The ribbons and the deadline sit around y 1220 to 1490: keep that band above y 1500, where short-video apps put their buttons and captions.

# Flash sale: beat plan

Default length 15 s. Tempo per beat (seconds): short 1.2, medium 1.8, long 2.4.

## hook

- en: a full-frame colour flash, then the sale words slam in from 2.6x one by one
- id: kilat warna sepenuh layar, lalu kata promo menghentak masuk dari 2,6x satu per satu

## problem

- en: the old price shakes
- id: harga lama bergetar

## fact

- en: a short line stamped in a pill with a small flash, then held
- id: kalimat pendek dicap dalam pill dengan kilat kecil, lalu diam

## step

- en: numbered chips pop in
- id: chip bernomor muncul

## compare

- en: old price struck, new price drops in
- id: harga lama dicoret, harga baru turun

## number

- en: the figure bursts in spinning, largest on screen, shakes, then a word slides in beside it
- id: angka meledak masuk sambil berputar, paling besar di layar, bergetar, lalu satu kata meluncur masuk

## proof

- en: a stamped badge
- id: badge dicap

## offer

- en: the offer runs on two crossed ribbons moving in opposite directions
- id: penawaran berjalan di dua pita bersilang yang bergerak berlawanan arah

## cta

- en: a colour circle opens from the centre onto name, button and contact, held 2 s
- id: lingkaran warna membuka dari tengah: nama, tombol, kontak, diam 2 detik

## payoff

- en: the offer recap, held 2 s
- id: ringkasan penawaran, diam 2 detik

<!doctype html>
<html lang="id">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=1080, height=1920" />
    <title>Flash sale</title>
    <script src="/_lib/gsap@3.15.1/gsap.min.js"></script>
    <style>
      @font-face { font-family: "Archivo Black"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 400; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Space Grotesk"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 500; }
      @font-face { font-family: "Space Grotesk"; src: url("data:font/woff2;base64,"); font-weight: 700; }
      /* Token brand (recipes/README.md): brand mengganti dua belas nilai pertama. Sesudahnya milik tampilan ini:
         teks di atas warna aksen, hitam atau putih mengikuti terang aksen, karena brand bisa menggantinya. */
      :root {
        --latar: #0d0d12; --latar-2: #1b1b24; --utama: #d7ff3a; --aksen: #ff2e88;
        --teks: #ffffff; --teks-redup: #a9a9b8; --teks-di-utama: #0d0d12;
        --teks-di-aksen: #14161a; --utama-di-latar: #d7ff3a; --aksen-di-latar: #ff2e88;
        --font-judul: "Archivo Black", "Noto Sans", sans-serif; --font-isi: "Space Grotesk", "Noto Sans", sans-serif;
      }
      * { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
      html, body { width: 1080px; height: 1920px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); }
      #root { position: relative; width: 100%; height: 100%; overflow: hidden; background: var(--latar); color: var(--teks);
        font-family: var(--font-isi); }
      .scene { position: absolute; inset: 0; }
      .grid { position: absolute; inset: -200px; opacity: 0.18;
        background-image: linear-gradient(var(--teks) 2px, transparent 2px), linear-gradient(90deg, var(--teks) 2px, transparent 2px);
        background-size: 120px 120px; }
      .flash { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: var(--utama); }
      .head { position: absolute; left: 70px; right: 70px; top: 300px; font-family: var(--font-judul); font-size: 170px;
        line-height: 0.95; text-transform: uppercase; }
      .head span { display: inline-block; }
      .head .b { color: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      .pct { position: absolute; left: 40px; right: 40px; top: 680px; text-align: center; font-family: var(--font-judul);
        font-size: 440px; line-height: 1; color: var(--aksen-di-latar); letter-spacing: -12px; }
      .off { position: absolute; right: 90px; top: 1100px; font-family: var(--font-judul); font-size: 120px; color: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      .tape { position: absolute; left: -200px; width: 1480px; height: 120px; overflow: hidden; display: flex; align-items: center; }
      .tape .run { white-space: nowrap; font-family: var(--font-judul); font-size: 70px; letter-spacing: 4px; }
      .t1 { top: 1280px; background: var(--utama); color: var(--teks-di-utama); transform: rotate(-7deg); }
      .t2 { top: 1290px; background: var(--aksen); color: var(--teks-di-aksen); transform: rotate(5deg); }
      .info { position: absolute; left: 80px; right: 80px; top: 1280px; text-align: center; }
      .info .label { font-size: 56px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 8px; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--utama-di-latar); }
      .tenggat { display: inline-block; margin-top: 18px; padding: 16px 40px; border-radius: 26px; background: var(--utama);
        color: var(--teks-di-utama); font-family: var(--font-judul); font-size: 80px; line-height: 1.1; white-space: nowrap; }
      .end { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
        background: var(--aksen); color: var(--teks-di-aksen); text-align: center; padding: 0 80px; }
      .end .toko { font-family: var(--font-judul); font-size: 120px; line-height: 1; }
      .end .ajak { margin-top: 40px; padding: 28px 60px; border-radius: 80px; background: var(--latar); color: var(--utama-di-latar);
        font-size: 62px; font-weight: 700; }
      .end .kontak { margin-top: 40px; font-size: 52px; font-weight: 500; }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <div id="root" data-composition-id="main" data-start="0" data-duration="15" data-width="1080" data-height="1920" data-fps="30">
      <div class="grid" id="grid"></div>
      <div class="flash" id="flash"></div>

      <div class="head" id="head" data-role="hook">
        <span>Flash</span><br /><span class="b">Sale!</span>
      </div>

      <div class="scene" id="diskon" data-role="number">
        <div class="pct" id="pct">50%</div>
        <div class="off" id="off">OFF</div>
      </div>

      <div class="scene" id="pita" data-role="offer">
        <div class="tape t2" id="t2"><div class="run" id="run2">SAMPAI MINGGU • SAMPAI MINGGU • SAMPAI MINGGU • SAMPAI MINGGU •</div></div>
        <div class="tape t1" id="t1"><div class="run" id="run1">SEMUA SNEAKERS • SEMUA SNEAKERS • SEMUA SNEAKERS • SEMUA SNEAKERS •</div></div>
      </div>

      <div class="info" id="info" data-role="fact">
        <div class="label" id="label">Berakhir</div>
        <!-- Tenggat ditulis sebagai teks agar tetap benar kapan pun video ditonton. -->
        <div class="tenggat" id="tenggat">Minggu, 23.59 WIB</div>
      </div>

      <div class="end" id="end" data-role="cta">
        <div class="toko">LANGKAH SHOES</div>
        <div class="ajak">Belanja sekarang</div>
        <div class="kontak">@langkahshoes · Ruko Sentosa B7</div>
      </div>
    </div>
    <script>
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });

      // Kilat pembuka, lalu judul menghentak kata demi kata.
      tl.fromTo("#flash", { opacity: 1 }, { opacity: 0, duration: 0.35, ease: "power2.out" }, 0.05)
        .fromTo("#grid", { y: 0 }, { y: 240, duration: 15, ease: "none" }, 0)
        .from("#head span", { scale: 2.6, opacity: 0, duration: 0.45, ease: "expo.out", stagger: 0.22, transformOrigin: "0% 50%" }, 0.15)
        // Persen meledak sambil berputar, lalu bergetar (jumlah ulangan tetap).
        .from("#pct", { scale: 0.2, rotation: -20, opacity: 0, duration: 0.7, ease: "back.out(2.2)" }, 0.8)
        .to("#pct", { x: 14, duration: 0.05, yoyo: true, repeat: 9, ease: "none" }, 1.5)
        .from("#off", { x: 300, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "expo.out" }, 1.6)
        // Dua pita bersilang masuk dari arah berlawanan dan teksnya berjalan berlawanan.
        .from("#t1", { xPercent: -100, duration: 0.6, ease: "expo.out" }, 2.0)
        .from("#t2", { xPercent: 100, duration: 0.6, ease: "expo.out" }, 2.2)
        .fromTo("#run1", { x: 0 }, { x: -900, duration: 9, ease: "none" }, 2.0)
        .fromTo("#run2", { x: -900 }, { x: 0, duration: 9, ease: "none" }, 2.2)
        .to(["#t1", "#t2"], { yPercent: -170, opacity: 0, duration: 0.4, ease: "power2.in" }, 4.6)
        // Tenggat dicap masuk dengan kilat kecil, lalu diam sampai penutup (sekitar 5 detik) supaya terbaca.
        .from("#label", { y: 80, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power3.out" }, 5.0)
        .from("#tenggat", { scale: 1.8, rotation: -6, opacity: 0, duration: 0.45, ease: "expo.out" }, 5.2)
        .fromTo("#flash", { opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 0.35, duration: 0.06, yoyo: true, repeat: 1, ease: "none", immediateRender: false }, 5.25)
        // Penutup: lingkaran warna membuka dari tengah, isinya naik bergantian, lalu diam.
        .fromTo("#end", { clipPath: "circle(0% at 50% 50%)" }, { clipPath: "circle(75% at 50% 50%)", duration: 0.8, ease: "expo.inOut" }, 11)
        .from("#end > *", { y: 80, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power3.out", stagger: 0.12 }, 11.5)
        .to("#root", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power2.in" }, 14.5);

      window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
      window.__timelines["main"] = tl;
    </script>
  </body>
</html>

    <script>
      const tl = gsap.timeline({ paused: true });

      // Kilat pembuka, lalu judul menghentak kata demi kata.
      tl.fromTo("#flash", { opacity: 1 }, { opacity: 0, duration: 0.35, ease: "power2.out" }, 0.05)
        .fromTo("#grid", { x: 0 }, { x: -240, duration: 15, ease: "none" }, 0)
        .from("#head span", { scale: 2.6, opacity: 0, duration: 0.45, ease: "expo.out", stagger: 0.22, transformOrigin: "0% 50%" }, 0.15)
        // Persen meledak sambil berputar, lalu bergetar (jumlah ulangan tetap).
        .from("#pct", { scale: 0.2, rotation: -20, opacity: 0, duration: 0.7, ease: "back.out(2.2)" }, 0.8)
        .to("#pct", { x: 14, duration: 0.05, yoyo: true, repeat: 9, ease: "none" }, 1.5)
        .from("#off", { y: 160, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "expo.out" }, 1.6)
        // Dua pita bersilang masuk dari arah berlawanan dan teksnya berjalan berlawanan.
        .from("#t1", { xPercent: -100, duration: 0.6, ease: "expo.out" }, 2.0)
        .from("#t2", { xPercent: 100, duration: 0.6, ease: "expo.out" }, 2.2)
        .fromTo("#run1", { x: 0 }, { x: -1100, duration: 9, ease: "none" }, 2.0)
        .fromTo("#run2", { x: -1100 }, { x: 0, duration: 9, ease: "none" }, 2.2)
        .to(["#t1", "#t2"], { yPercent: -170, opacity: 0, duration: 0.4, ease: "power2.in" }, 4.6)
        // Tenggat dicap masuk dengan kilat kecil, lalu diam sampai penutup (sekitar 5 detik) supaya terbaca.
        .from("#label", { y: 80, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power3.out" }, 5.0)
        .from("#tenggat", { scale: 1.8, rotation: -6, opacity: 0, duration: 0.45, ease: "expo.out" }, 5.2)
        .fromTo("#flash", { opacity: 0 }, { opacity: 0.35, duration: 0.06, yoyo: true, repeat: 1, ease: "none", immediateRender: false }, 5.25)
        // Penutup: lingkaran warna membuka dari tengah, isinya naik bergantian, lalu diam.
        .fromTo("#end", { clipPath: "circle(0% at 50% 50%)" }, { clipPath: "circle(75% at 50% 50%)", duration: 0.8, ease: "expo.inOut" }, 11)
        .from("#end > *", { y: 80, opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power3.out", stagger: 0.12 }, 11.5)
        .to("#root", { opacity: 0, duration: 0.5, ease: "power2.in" }, 14.5);

      window.__timelines = window.__timelines || {};
      window.__timelines["main"] = tl;
    </script>
